title: First Unique Character in a String
description: Find the index of the first non-repeating character.

data.text: Given a string `s`, find the first non-repeating character and return its index. If it does not exist, return `-1`.

data.title: Two-pass with dictionary O(n)
int[26] counts O(n)
What improved?
data.text: Same two-pass logic, but the fixed array removes dictionary lookups and makes counting faster for lowercase letters.
